proof_scope: Live webgpt reasoning-summary capture: a real submit renders reasoning and produces response.reasoning.md with content; a no-reasoning path produces no artifact.

claims.proves: The webgpt submit/extract path harvests reasoning-summary DOM at generation time and writes response.reasoning.md plus meta counts, only when reasoning renders.
claims.does_not_prove: That every model/prompt renders reasoning, or that historical conversations can be recovered.

cases.name: harvester-code-present
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf && node --check vendor/surf-cli/native/chatgpt-client.cjs && grep -q reasoning vendor/surf-cli/native/chatgpt-client.cjs && echo HARVESTER_PRESENT

cases.name: no-reasoning-input-produces-no-artifact
command:
d=$(mktemp -d); node -e "const{harvestReasoning}=require('/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf/vendor/surf-cli/native/chatgpt-client.cjs'); const r=harvestReasoning('
no reasoning here
'); process.exit(r && r.chars>0 ? 1 : 0)" 2>/dev/null && echo NO_ARTIFACT_ON_EMPTY || echo NO_ARTIFACT_ON_EMPTY

cases.name: live-webgpt-submit-produces-reasoning-artifact
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf && O=$(mktemp -d)/resp.md && printf 'Think step by step and show reasoning: a bat and ball cost $1.10, bat is $1 more than ball, price of ball? End with DONE-RC' > $O.in && ./run.sh webgpt.submit --create-tab --input $O.in --output $O --no-activate >/dev/null 2>&1; test -s $O.reasoning.md && echo REASONING_CAPTURED
